messages:
Ana (Product): Quick async Q2 milestone tally — please drop a one-line status for your owned milestones: shipped / slipped / at-risk + immediate blocker. I'll compile by EOD PT.

Sam (Eng): Runtime v2 canary done -> shipped. Latency looks good at 95th. PR #4892 merged. No blockers :tada:

Liam (Eng-Platform): Dedicated autoscaler improvements slipped one sprint, owner @liam. Blocker: need infra quota approval from finance. Filing ticket: INF-121.

Maya (Eng-ML): Model-quant pipeline shipped yesterday, but quantized 4-bit runs show +2% regen-error on tests. Will run rollback on bad prompts, pinging @sam for perf runs.

Jordan (PM): Thanks — note downstream: Mobile client feature depends on Dedicated autoscaler change (owner @dev-mobile). If autoscaler slips, mobile ship moves.

Sam (Eng): @liam can you drop the quota ask as a short doc? I can escalate in the finance channel.

Liam (Eng-Platform): Dropped INF-121 doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-121 — short TL;DR in the doc, @sam please +1 if you can escalate.

Ana (Product): CR ping: please review these PRs before EOD if you own the milestone: #4892, #4910, #4925. Small description:
- #4892 runtime canary (shipped)
- #4910 autoscaler tweak (blocked)
- #4925 quant pipeline safety tests (in review)

Maya (Eng-ML): Assigned reviewer on #4925: @sam and @liam. Small failing test snapshot below:
```
AssertionError: output similarity < 0.78
Failing prompt: "summarize: Long tail customer logs"
```
I'll add more cases to the eval harness.

Sam (Eng): On it — will try to land review in morning. If I need help, I'll call out specific diffs.

CI Bot: Build 2023.06.14-984 passed for #4892, queued for #4925.

Jordan (PM): Next steps: Ana to send rollup; Eng leads to confirm owners + ETA for slipped items by lunchtime PT. Mobile PM @dev-mobile to consider contingency.

Ana (Product): Copying plan: I'll collate statuses and make a one-slide handoff for execs. If any milestoned item is actually blocked by external teams, mention the contact person. Thanks!

Liam (Eng-Platform): ETA for quota approval = tomorrow 1800 PT if finance replies today. Marking autoscaler as at-risk for next checkpoint.

Maya (Eng-ML): For regressions, proposing temporary revert flag: runtime flag --disable-quantization. If agreed, we can toggle without rollback. @sam urgent: could we add toggle config?

Sam (Eng): Yes, can add flag in 2hrs, will open PR and ping.

Ana (Product): Great — please update this thread when PRs merged or blockers resolved. I'll close the tally at 18:00 PT.
